why.en: I love songs that enumerate things, and this is my favorite one! From things that don't kill you, to dictators and evil companies, to philosophy and mindset. A tribute to resilience.
You can really feel love has ended for this man — he takes you right along with him.

It's not my favorite because I don't have one, but it pops into my head whenever I'm asked the question. It's incredibly romantic — my favorite part is "A te che sei la miglior cosa che mi sia successa, a te che cambi tutti i giorni, e resti sempre la stessa." It encapsulates the beauty of always growing but retaining your essence, and I think that's beautiful.
